channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Evan Mobley | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Evan Mobley from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Koby Altman on Evan Mobley
item.description:
Koby Altman on Evan Mobley:

“He was arguably our best player in the playoffs. All we’ve done was win since he’s been here. He has a chip on his shoulder. He wants to get back to that DPOY, All Star level. He’s gonna take a leap this year.”

Koby Altman on Evan Mobley, Sep 25, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo on Evan Mobley
item.description:
The insider said,

“I don’t think it’ll be long before you start to hear the Cavs attached to Giannis Antetokounmpo. If they put Evan Mobley on the table, what if they can turn him into Giannis?”

Giannis Antetokounmpo on Evan Mobley, May 26, 2026. Source: Pro Football Network.

item.title: Donovan Mitchell on Evan Mobley
item.description:
#CavsDonovan Mitchell on Evan Mobley:

“He was aggressive. Didn't feel like anybody could stay in front of him and he was dominant on the glass. Especially when they went small, that's what he is supposed to do. That's the aggression we want to see on a continuous basis from him”

Donovan Mitchell on Evan Mobley, Mar 18, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: John Wall on Donovan Mitchell, Jarrett Allen, Darius Garland, Evan Mobley
item.description:
Oh No He Didn't: John Wall on the Cavs:

“I think they gotta make a big change. Donovan Mitchell, Darius Garland are just not getting along in that backcourtand I think with Jarrett Allen and Evan Mobley they're just too soft”

John Wall on Donovan Mitchell, Jarrett Allen, Darius Garland, Evan Mobley, Dec 27, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Blake Griffin on Evan Mobley
item.description:
Blake Griffin opened up about a similar experience, which brought him to the same revelation.

“I was playing in Boston, which was my last year. We’re playing in Cleveland at the time. I check into the game. A couple of minutes left in the first quarter, going up and down. I’ve got Evan Mobley. Jumper, come back down, hook, come back down, put back,”

Blake Griffin on Evan Mobley, Nov 8, 2025. Source: The Sports Rush.

item.title: Blake Griffin on Evan Mobley
item.description:
However, Mobley’s physical state afterwards was the nail in the coffin for Griffin’s career.

“Somebody got fouled. We’re both on the free-throw line. I’m like [dying]. And I look over at Evan Mobley, it’s like he’s just getting started. I was like, ‘What’s wrong with this guy?'”

Blake Griffin on Evan Mobley, Nov 8, 2025. Source: The Sports Rush.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Evan Mobley
item.description:
Danny Cunningham:Atkinson:

“You'll notice how much stronger [Evan Mobley] has gotten... Youjust sense that he's ready to make another jump... He's different. I don't know how to exactly define that, but there's a confidence brewing there that maybe we haven't seen before.”

Kenny Atkinson on Evan Mobley, Sep 23, 2025. Source: Twitter @RealDCunningham.

item.title: Koby Altman on Evan Mobley
item.description:
Cleveland Cavaliers President Koby Altman on Defensive Player of the Year Evan Mobley:

“We’re going to go as a franchise as Evan is going to go. We’ve had that conversation with Evan… We think we have one of the best big men in the game in Evan Mobley.”

Koby Altman on Evan Mobley, May 19, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Draymond Green on Evan Mobley, Dyson Daniels
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“Oh man, I think—put it in the bag. That’s what I think. Put it in the bag. Yours truly. That’s who I’m rocking with. Listen, I think Evan Mobley has had a great year. Dyson Daniels has had a great year. I think Zubac has had a great year. All those guys have had great years. I ain’t taking nothing away from them—and I see them on First-Team All-Defense. But I think DPOY should go to yours truly. I’ll take that.”

Draymond Green on Evan Mobley, Dyson Daniels, Apr 13, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Evan Mobley
item.description:
“But what I see right now is that a big part of his player-development plan and on-court work is dedicated to the 3-point shot. And then with that 3-point shooting comes close-out offense … (defenses) start to close out (on Mobley, which draws defenders away from the paint).”

Kenny Atkinson on Evan Mobley, Jan 16, 2025. Source: New York Times.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Evan Mobley
item.description:
JB Bickerstaff:

“I think this series was a huge statement for Evan (Mobley)… he really went out and tried to put an imprint on winning, like he always does.”

JB Bickerstaff on Evan Mobley, May 15, 2024. Source: Twitter @TimBontemps.

item.title: Donovan Mitchell on Darius Garland, Evan Mobley
item.description:
Mitchell told cleveland.com on Saturday.

“I’m on social media so I see it. You hear it. We all do. It’s the easy thing to point to. It’s easy to fall into that. We live in this world that always likes to create controversy. We just had a really good stretch. We just went on a run. But that speaks to our team and our group. At the end of the day, we are a complete team. That’s more of the reason for our recent success. That’s a better way to explain this situation. It’s not about who is not playing. We won 51 games with Darius and Ev [Evan Mobley] last year. We wouldn’t be here without them. We need those guys.”

Donovan Mitchell on Darius Garland, Evan Mobley, Feb 4, 2024. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.

item.title: Georges Niang on Evan Mobley
item.description:
Georges Niang on Evan Mobley (after hyping up his ability to protect the rim + play in the mid post):

“I think the coolest thing about Evan is that he's so eager to be better every single day...and he hasn't even scratched the surface of what he could be.”

Georges Niang on Evan Mobley, Oct 14, 2023. Source: Twitter @SerenaWinters.

item.title: Georges Niang on Rudy Gobert, Evan Mobley
item.description:
#Cavs Georges Niang on whether he sees similarities between Evan Mobley and Rudy Gobert:

“I would say Evan’s ability to protect the rim is, I don’t want to make a quote and have it go viral, but it’s along the lines of how Rudy Gobert protects the rim.”

Georges Niang on Rudy Gobert, Evan Mobley, Oct 14, 2023. Source: Twitter @ChrisFedor.

item.title: Donovan Mitchell on Evan Mobley
item.description:
#Cavs Donovan Mitchell on Evan Mobley's leap:

“Despite what people said at the beginning of the year, I kept the receipts for him on Twitter. People said a lot about him at the beginning of the year, about him not taking that step and I haven’t heard much of that since”

Donovan Mitchell on Evan Mobley, Mar 31, 2023. Source: Twitter @ChrisFedor.

item.title: Donovan Mitchell on Evan Mobley
item.description:
Danny Cunningham:#Cavs Donovan Mitchell on Evan Mobley’s DPOY case:

“He should be the Defensive Player of the Year. I’ve played with a three-time Defensive Player of the Year, so I know what it looks like and I’m seeing it with him, for sure.”

Donovan Mitchell on Evan Mobley, Mar 31, 2023. Source: Twitter @RealDCunningham.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Evan Mobley
item.description:
“[Mobley] has a ton of respect for the players that are great in this game and he is competitive enough to want to be better than them,”

JB Bickerstaff on Evan Mobley, Dec 6, 2022. Source: ESPN.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Evan Mobley
item.description:
#CavsJ.B. Bickerstaff on Evan Mobley:

“We want him in the Defensive Player of the Year conversation. That is the type of player we know he can be.”

JB Bickerstaff on Evan Mobley, Sep 26, 2022. Source: Twitter @ChrisFedor.

item.title: Onyeka Okongwu on Evan Mobley, Isaiah Mobley
item.description:
“In high school I was playing with Lonzo and Melo, and when I was in AAU, I was playing with the Mobley brothers, Evan Mobley and Isaiah Mobley. I've been playing with high-level talent for my whole life. So with that experience, I just know how to play with really good basketball players. I know how to make them better and they know how to make me better, and that's how we mesh on the court. That's why in AAU with the Mobleys, we were so successful. That's why in high school with Melo, we were so successful. We know how to play competitively and we know how to play the right way.”

Onyeka Okongwu on Evan Mobley, Isaiah Mobley, Apr 23, 2022. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Nicolas Batum on Lauri Markkanen, Evan Mobley
item.description:
Law Murray:Nicolas Batum on Evan Mobley and gargantuan Cavaliers lineup:

“They got Markkanen at the 3, right? So I mean, that's unusual for sure. But you know, we got to face that to find a way to win this game. Mobley's doing great things for a youngster...”

Nicolas Batum on Lauri Markkanen, Evan Mobley, Oct 27, 2021. Source: Twitter @LawMurrayTheNU.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Evan Mobley, Larry Nance Jr
item.description:
#CavsJ.B. Bickerstaff on replacing Larry Nance Jr.'s defense:

“I think the plan is systematically, putting something in place where five guys are looking to cover and protect for one another. I think Evan (Mobley) has all the tools to be a similar type defender as Larry.”

JB Bickerstaff on Evan Mobley, Larry Nance Jr, Sep 29, 2021. Source: Twitter @ChrisFedor.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Evan Mobley
item.description:
#CavsJ.B. Bickerstaff on Evan Mobley:

“We will be cautious of too much, too soon, but I think his game is going to dictate what too much is. We don’t want to put the weight of the world on his shoulders. We’re building this team & then talent always rises to the top”

JB Bickerstaff on Evan Mobley, Sep 29, 2021. Source: Twitter @ChrisFedor.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Evan Mobley
item.description:
#CavsJ.B. Bickerstaff on Evan Mobley's first day:

“He was great. This morning was a lot of teaching and that’s one of his strengths. He picks up things extremely quickly. You can tell him one time and he can explain it to other people, that’s how quickly he picks it up”

JB Bickerstaff on Evan Mobley, Sep 28, 2021. Source: Twitter @ChrisFedor.

item.title: Koby Altman on Evan Mobley
item.description:
Rick Noland:Altman on Mobley:

“He has a tremendous skill set for a guy who's 7 feet. We're going to use him all over the court.”

Koby Altman on Evan Mobley, Sep 27, 2021. Source: Twitter @RickNoland.
